title: Electronics order items across four tables
prompt: Return the order id (as order_id), customer name (as customer_name), product name (as product_name), and quantity for every order item where the product belongs to the 'Electronics' category. Join the orders, order items, products, and categories tables.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE ord7 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_date TEXT, customer_name TEXT); INSERT INTO ord7 VALUES (1,'2024-01-01','Alice'),(2,'2024-01-02','Bob'),(3,'2024-01-03','Carol'); CREATE TABLE item7 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER, quantity INTEGER); INSERT INTO item7 VALUES (1,1,1,1),(2,1,3,2),(3,2,2,1),(4,3,4,4); CREATE TABLE prod7 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category_id INTEGER); INSERT INTO prod7 VALUES (1,'Laptop',1),(2,'Phone',1),(3,'Desk',2),(4,'Chair',2); CREATE TABLE cat7 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO cat7 VALUES (1,'Electronics'),(2,'Furniture');
reference_sql: SELECT ord7.id AS order_id, ord7.customer_name, prod7.name AS product_name, item7.quantity FROM ord7 JOIN item7 ON ord7.id = item7.order_id JOIN prod7 ON item7.product_id = prod7.id JOIN cat7 ON prod7.category_id = cat7.id WHERE cat7.name = 'Electronics';
